facts.fact: KICTANet reports Kenya launched an AI & Emerging Technologies Technical Committee to develop the country's first national AI and Emerging Technologies policy, led by the Ministry of Information Communication and the Digital Economy, with substantial drafts due by March 2026 and finalisation targeted for June 2026.

facts.fact: KICTANet, a Kenyan organisation, is lead implementing partner of the ministry-led committee developing the national AI and Emerging Technologies policy, whose members include academics and civil society experts.

KEN.note: Committee only launched and roundtables only scheduled; no consultation or opinion shown to have happened, and the late-2025 workshop's participants are not named.
